shots.purpose: Open mid-symptom: a core glowing amber while the skin surface shivers — the paradox stated in one image
shots.claim: fever is a regulated rise of the body's temperature set point, orchestrated by the brain
shots.evidence: blood-warm dark-field cutaway figure: amber core glow, shiver arcs at the skin, clamped teal vessels, 39C dial readout
shots.motion_reason: slow push-in so hot-core-versus-cold-skin reads immediately

depth.note: shiver arcs in front of the body plane

subject_contract.expected_subject: blood-warm cutaway figure with amber core glow and skin shiver arcs

shots.purpose: Locate the thermostat: cutaway head with hypothalamus lit at the brain's base, baseline dial beside it
shots.claim: the hypothalamus acts as the body's thermostat for core temperature
shots.evidence: cutaway head profile, rose brain mass with rust gyri, amber hypothalamus dot, 37-degree set-point gauge
shots.motion_reason: gentle drift toward the lit hypothalamus dot
shots.transition_reason: cut from body to head cutaway

subject_contract.expected_subject: cutaway head with lit hypothalamus and baseline set-point dial

shots.purpose: The mechanism reveal: cytokine dots travel the vessel into the hypothalamus and the dial turns to 39
shots.claim: pyrogenic cytokines induce prostaglandin E2 in the hypothalamus, raising the set point
shots.evidence: rust cytokine dots streaming down a teal vessel into the amber hypothalamus, dial needle at 39, +1-2C number
shots.motion_reason: flow animation follows the cytokine path, then the needle sweeps

subject_contract.expected_subject: cytokine flow into lit hypothalamus with dial swept to 39

shots.purpose: The climb: clamped vessels, shiver marks, amber heat arrows running inward to the core
shots.claim: vasoconstriction and shivering raise core temperature toward the raised set point
shots.evidence: thin teal clamped vessels, zigzag shiver arcs on muscle, three amber arrows pushing heat toward the glowing core
shots.motion_reason: arrows animate inward while shiver arcs pulse
shots.transition_reason: cut from head to body cutaway

subject_contract.expected_subject: body cutaway with clamped vessels, shiver arcs and inward amber heat arrows

shots.purpose: The stake: a slow rust pathogen chain on the left, a bristling immune cell on the right — the trade-off shown
shots.claim: moderate fever can slow pathogens and support immunity; very high fever harms; net benefit is debated
shots.evidence: linked rust rings (sluggish chain) beside a large rust immune cell with an amber nucleus and bristling receptors, debate caption chip
shots.motion_reason: receptors pulse outward; chain links drift slowly

depth.note: receptors in front of cell body

subject_contract.expected_subject: slow pathogen chain versus activated immune cell, split by a hairline

shots.purpose: The descent: dial unwinds to baseline, vessels open wide, sweat beads lift off the skin
shots.claim: antipyretics inhibit prostaglandin synthesis; the falling set point drives vasodilation and sweating
shots.evidence: wide teal vessels glowing on flushed skin, sweat beads above the shoulder line, dial back at 37

depth.note: beads in front of skin plane

subject_contract.expected_subject: flushed figure with wide open vessels, rising sweat beads, dial at baseline

shots.purpose: Resolve the loop: the same cutaway at rest, chills marked as the climb and sweat as the descent
shots.claim: fever symptoms follow the set-point trajectory: chills on the ramp, sweat on the descent
shots.evidence: calm cutaway figure, amber up arrow on the left, teal down arrow on the right, dial at baseline between them

subject_contract.expected_subject: resolved cutaway with baseline dial, climb and descent arrows framed symmetrically
